correctness.rationale: The trace-form orthogonal-image identity is characteristic-independent. Its block-projector and polynomial-centralizer proof forces precisely p-divisibility of every nonzero eigen Jordan-block length, and is sufficient. Rational canonical decomposition then yields all allowable finite-field types. Kernel dimension gives exact affine fibers. Rational-canonical centralizer-unit orders cancel the powers of q, and the finite q-binomial product yields the claimed all-n generating series; the sharp n=p threshold and dimension-two formulas are recomputed explicitly. Exhaustive direct pair counts over q=2,3,4 and sampled q=3,4 dimension-three affine tests support but do not replace the general proof.
